info.title: 同频 TONE API
info.description: MySQL-backed server. NetEase uses hana-music-api 3.2.0 programmatically on Node.js 24+; existing HTTP contracts and stored cookies are preserved. Internal-only Netease account jobs run daily at 08:00 Asia/Shanghai; committed playback asynchronously reports full track duration while playing. Maintenance/scrobble methods are not exposed by the HTTP proxy. See docs/NETEASE.md for bounded queues, credential gating and persisted daily attempts. Registration and login use username and password only. WebSocket protocol is documented separately in docs/API.md and docs/PROTOCOL.md. Music is stored as direct provider URLs and expiry timestamps. See docs/API.md for bounded refresh, 100 MiB bounded downloads and client-side MD5 verification.
